speaker: Marta
text: Thanks for making the time, Dana. Halden Works runs the cold-chain network for three regional grocers.

speaker: Dana
text: Happy to be here. I read your brief on the sensor pilot last night.

speaker: Marta
text: We want sensors on forty trucks by the end of November. Could you send the pilot plan by Friday?

speaker: Dana
text: Yes, I will send the pilot plan by Friday with the staffing and the timeline.

speaker: Joe
text: On our side the data team needs the API schema before they start any integration work.

speaker: Dana
text: I will include the schema in the same email, together with the sample payloads.

speaker: Marta
text: The budget is capped at sixty thousand euros for the pilot phase, travel included.

speaker: Dana
text: Understood. Sixty thousand covers the sensors, the install crew and three months of monitoring.

speaker: Joe
text: One risk is the depot in Rovigo. The cellular signal inside the cold room is poor.

speaker: Dana
text: Then we should test two gateway options there before we commit to the forty trucks.

speaker: Marta
text: Agreed. Joe will arrange access to the Rovigo depot for the week of the ninth.

speaker: Joe
text: I can do the ninth. I need the names of your installers a week before.

speaker: Dana
text: I will send the installer names with the pilot plan.

speaker: Marta
text: Who signs the data processing agreement on your side?

speaker: Dana
text: Our finance lead signs. I will ask her to send the draft to Joe this week.

speaker: Joe
text: Good. Our legal team needs five working days to review it.

speaker: Marta
text: Let us meet again on the twenty-sixth to review the plan together.

speaker: Dana
text: The twenty-sixth works. I will send an invite after this call.

speaker: Marta
text: Last point. Please keep the pilot plan to two pages. The board reads it.

speaker: Dana
text: Two pages, with the risks on the first page.

speaker: Marta
text: Perfect. Thank you both.

speaker: Joe
text: Thanks everyone.
